newsitem.title: USA: Clintons depart White House for New Year's retreat.
newsitem.headline: Clintons depart White House for New Year's retreat.

text.p: U.S. President Bill Clinton, first lady Hillary Rodham Clinton and their daughter Chelsea departed the White House on Monday for a week-long private trip to South Carolina and the U.S. Virgin Islands.
The Clintons departed the White House via helicopter en route to Andrews Air Force Base in nearby Maryland, where they are scheduled to depart on Air Force One for Hilton Head, South Carolina.

There, the Clintons are scheduled to attend the annual Renaissance Weekend, an invitation-only gathering comprised of seminars and lectures on a range of topics. They are scheduled to be in Hilton Head until Jan. 1.
The Clintons will then leave South Carolina for St. Thomas in the Virgin Islands for what a White House schedule described as "private time."
The Clintons will return to Washington on Sunday, Jan. 5.
